interfaces.name: yaw_servo_case
interfaces.what: top plate underside: 4 x Ø2.5 M2 clearance holes at (-22.5, +-8) and (7.5, +-8) — the XL330's 30 x 16 case pattern; the head-yaw servo hangs under the plate between the walls, output down, its horn bolting to neck_pitch's top boss (yaw axis mesh -z through (0,0))
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh by cecad.meshfeatures (4 x Ø2.5, residual 0.000; Ø4.6 x 0.5 countersinks on the (7.5,+-8) pair) + meshslice z 17 probes, 2026-09-02

interfaces.name: roll_horn
interfaces.what: Ø18 disc + Ø16 x 1.9 boss face with Ø6 centre bore and 4 x Ø2.2 on a Ø12 bolt circle, counterbored Ø4.4 from y 12 — the head-roll XL330 (in the head's motor_support) bolts its horn here; the roll axis is mesh +y through (0, 4.5)
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh by cecad.meshfeatures (boss Ø16 len 1.9 at y 16.95, Ø6 len 5.9, 4 x Ø2.2 len 3.4 at y 16.2, Ø4.4 cbores at y 13.25) + meshslice probes, 2026-09-02

interfaces.name: roll_bearing_seat
interfaces.what: Ø16.0 x 4.0 boss with Ø12 through bore — inner-race seat for the 22x16x4 bearing held in the head, coaxial with the head-roll axis, opposite the roll horn
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh by cecad.meshfeatures (boss Ø16.00 len 4.0 at (0, -16, 4.5), hole Ø12.00 len 8.0), 2026-09-02

record.frame: Pollen's mesh frame for yaw_roll_motion.stl: x -24.5..9.5, y -18..17.9, z -4.5..18. Head-yaw axis along mesh z through (0,0); head-roll axis along mesh y through (0, 4.5). Kept so the MJCF geom pos/quat (pos (0,0,10), quat 90 deg about z) place it directly.
